build_LMTransformer: build a ByteLatent language model transformer using LMTransformerArgs to configure vocab size, layers, and dimensions
run_LMTransformer_forward: run the LMTransformer forward pass with token values and optional target tensor to get logits or loss
create_LMTransformerArgs: create an LMTransformerArgs config with vocab size, weight tying, sliding window, and seed settings
build_fsdp_grouping_plan: build an FSDP grouping plan for fully sharded data parallel training of the LMTransformer model
tp_parallelize: parallelize the LMTransformer model across tensor parallel devices using column-wise and row-wise parallel strategies
